lessons_used: Wait-time information changes on home (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Adding a new screen at finish (finish, new_screen) was helpful, producing a win in 1 of 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder), which won its single test, as well as for all other change categories with 1 test.
Copy changes on sign-in (sign_in, copy) showed no clear positive effect across 2 tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across almost all non-winning tests.
Both winning tests (sign_in, reorder and finish, new_screen) were significantly underpredicted.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful, winning both of its tests.
Adding a new screen at finish (finish, new_screen) was helpful, winning 1 of 2 tests.

Wait-time information changes on home (home, wait_info), copy changes on sign-in (sign_in, copy), and copy changes on path selection (choose_path, copy) showed no clear positive effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence remains thin for all change categories tested only once.
Predictions were consistently too high for non-winning tests.
